$comment: Bound exceptions for scripts/ci/check-cargo-advisories.py over Cargo.lock. Every entry is bound by `advisory`, `package`, `version`, `informational`, and `reason`. Any security vulnerability (`informational` is null or `unsound`) without a bound entry fails CI; any moved version, package, or classification fails CI; any stale entry whose advisory is no longer reported fails CI.

advisories.reason: Compile-time host proc-macro transitive dependency pulled in by Linux GTK/Tauri derive crates; ships zero code in runtime desktop, mobile, or browser binaries and carries no known vulnerability. Remove this entry when upstream Tauri/GTK derive crates drop proc-macro-error.
